The work includes construction of concrete foundations and pads, installation of steel bollards and posts, curb and gutter modifications, and coordination with existing site features such as utilities, drainage structures, and adjacent facilities. Electrical scope includes new equipment, backup battery panels, conduit, and integration with existing power and communications systems to support automated gate operations. The project requires careful site coordination, traffic control, and maintenance of operations within an active Red Rocks Amphitheatre environment.
